about: Hand-reviewed project histories for the Accountability console. Each project strings together records that are already on the site (CRA ledger, contracts, change orders, votes) into one timeline from first budget to close-out. Every event cites its source. build_projects.py adds the change-order contracts and sales tax projects automatically and applies the flag rules. 'cos' pulls in a change-order group from data/contracts (government, vendor id, words in its title). 'checks' are flags a person confirmed by reading the documents; they are listed with the rule they fall under.
